# LongLive2 integration workspace

This directory is reserved for a local copy of
[`NVlabs/LongLive`](https://github.com/NVlabs/LongLive), which contains
LongLive2.

Fetch it with:

```bash
bash scripts/fetch_longlive2.sh --vendor
```

The planned refer-sink integration is documented in
[`docs/longlive2_refer_sink_plan.md`](../../docs/longlive2_refer_sink_plan.md).
